title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 110 East Powerhouse Road in Collegeville, Minnesota, as the "Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 110 East Powerhouse Road in Collegeville, Minnesota, as the "Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office."

summary.headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 110 East Powerhouse Road in Collegeville, Minnesota, the "Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law officially gives a name to a post office building in Collegeville, Minnesota. The building is now called the Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office. The law does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
